protocol_metadata.about: Re7 Labs is the DeFi innovation arm of Re7 Capital, a London-based crypto investment firm. It acts as a risk curator and vault manager, deploying ERC-4626 vaults on platforms such as Morpho Blue and Euler v2 across 15 chains, selecting collateral assets, setting LTV parameters, and allocating depositor capital to lending markets. Re7 Labs does not custody user assets directly; users deposit into smart-contract vaults and Re7 Labs holds curator-role permissions to reallocate capital within those vaults. The protocol charges a performance fee (reported at 10–20% of yield) and applies 24–48 hour timelocks on vault reallocations.
